programme.title: Hercules
programme.desc: Lou Ferrigno (star of the 1970s/80s TV series The Incredible Hulk), Sybil Danning, Ingrid Anderson and Mirella D'Angelo take the lead roles in Italian writer-director Luigi Cozzi's mythological romp for the low-budget action specialists The Cannon Group. The narrative starts with the creation of the universe, at the end of which Pandora's jar is broken, releasing evil into the world. Greek god Zeus (Claudio Cassinelli) decides to protect mankind from evil by creating a hero and sends divine light down to Bronze Age Thebes, where it enters the body of a royal baby. The infant survives a bloody palace coup instigated by Adriana (Danning), daughter of a rival monarch, and the malicious interventions of Zeus's wronged wife Hera (Rossana Podestŕ) to become the immensely strong Hercules (Ferrigno). But adulthood doesn't see an end to the relentless campaign to destroy him. And when Adriana captures his love Cassiopea (Anderson), Hercules joins forces with the sorceress Circe (D'Angelo) to save Cassiopea.

programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.title: Vimbldonas. Official Film
programme.desc: Wimbledon is more than just a tennis tournament — it's a summer tradition, a slice of British culture, and one of the most iconic sporting events in the world. Held every year in London, England, usually in late June to early July, it's where the best tennis players on the planet come to battle it out on the famous grass courts of the All England Club. It's actually the oldest tennis tournament in the world, dating back to 1877, and it's still the only Grand Slam played on grass — the fastest and most unpredictable surface. That's part of what makes it so exciting. Matches are intense, fast-paced, and full of surprises. Wimbledon is packed with unique traditions that make it stand out. Players are required to wear all white on court — no exceptions. The crowd enjoys strawberries and cream, and you won't see flashy ads around the court — it's all about the game. And of course, there's the Royal Box, where you might spot celebrities or even members of the British Royal Family watching the action. From rising stars to tennis legends, everyone dreams of lifting the famous Wimbledon trophy. There's something magical about seeing players walk onto Centre Court, hearing the roar of the crowd, and witnessing moments that go down in sports history. Whether you're a tennis fan or just love great sports drama, Wimbledon is a must-watch — classy, thrilling, and full of unforgettable moments.

programme.title: Vimbldonas. Official Film
programme.desc: Wimbledon is more than just a tennis tournament — it's a summer tradition, a slice of British culture, and one of the most iconic sporting events in the world. Held every year in London, England, usually in late June to early July, it's where the best tennis players on the planet come to battle it out on the famous grass courts of the All England Club. It's actually the oldest tennis tournament in the world, dating back to 1877, and it's still the only Grand Slam played on grass — the fastest and most unpredictable surface. That's part of what makes it so exciting. Matches are intense, fast-paced, and full of surprises. Wimbledon is packed with unique traditions that make it stand out. Players are required to wear all white on court — no exceptions. The crowd enjoys strawberries and cream, and you won't see flashy ads around the court — it's all about the game. And of course, there's the Royal Box, where you might spot celebrities or even members of the British Royal Family watching the action. From rising stars to tennis legends, everyone dreams of lifting the famous Wimbledon trophy. There's something magical about seeing players walk onto Centre Court, hearing the roar of the crowd, and witnessing moments that go down in sports history. Whether you're a tennis fan or just love great sports drama, Wimbledon is a must-watch — classy, thrilling, and full of unforgettable moments.

programme.title: Vimbldonas. Official Film
programme.desc: Wimbledon is more than just a tennis tournament — it's a summer tradition, a slice of British culture, and one of the most iconic sporting events in the world. Held every year in London, England, usually in late June to early July, it's where the best tennis players on the planet come to battle it out on the famous grass courts of the All England Club. It's actually the oldest tennis tournament in the world, dating back to 1877, and it's still the only Grand Slam played on grass — the fastest and most unpredictable surface. That's part of what makes it so exciting. Matches are intense, fast-paced, and full of surprises. Wimbledon is packed with unique traditions that make it stand out. Players are required to wear all white on court — no exceptions. The crowd enjoys strawberries and cream, and you won't see flashy ads around the court — it's all about the game. And of course, there's the Royal Box, where you might spot celebrities or even members of the British Royal Family watching the action. From rising stars to tennis legends, everyone dreams of lifting the famous Wimbledon trophy. There's something magical about seeing players walk onto Centre Court, hearing the roar of the crowd, and witnessing moments that go down in sports history. Whether you're a tennis fan or just love great sports drama, Wimbledon is a must-watch — classy, thrilling, and full of unforgettable moments.

programme.title: Kingdom of the Polar Bears
programme.desc: As the Arctic changes faster than ever, a team of polar bear guides prepares for an epic journey; a first-ever attempt to follow the bears on the sea ice of Hudson Bay. In this high-stakes high-reward venture, they will document the secret world of bears, a mysterious and disappearing realm that is the bears key to survival. Life on the ice is a critical time for these bears. It also remains undocumented, deemed too dangerous for humans to follow, hinted at only through aerial reconnaissance and satellite collar research. The team, armed with traditional ecological knowledge and the latest 4K camera technology, will witness never- before-seen seal hunting strategies and document rapid adaptations to climate change, including whale predation and open-water hunting.

programme.title: Europe's New Wild
programme.desc: This stunning six-part nature series tells the inspiring story of the rebirthing of the wild regions of the continent of Europe. A land formerly full of diverse wildlife and contrasting landscapes, Europe was in need of special rewilding teams to embark on a mission to return species to their natural habitat and this series focuses on six regions that have benefitted from the project. The Carpathian Mountains of Romania have seen the reintroduction of European bison while rural depopulation in Spain and Portugal offers up the opportunity to expand the wild nature of the Iberian Peninsula. The teams also look at how bears and humans can live peacefully, side by side and explores the myriad creatures that call the Danube Delta home. The unique culture and atmosphere of Lapland plays host to distinctive wildlife and the Sámi people and a natural balance is being restored to the Balkans.

Chamois, cuckoos, Ural owls, wild boar, lynx, brown bears, and huge wolf packs also thrive in a natural world beyond Bram Stoker's imagination.

programme.title: Mara: Rebirth
programme.desc: Part 2 sets the scene, now the zebras wander off, a striped echo of part one. If the first episode is dusted in browns and yellows, this is green as the landscape changes and the rain turn again, rising rivers, making it difficult for everyone again, flooding, rushing waters in a raging torrent. Paradise it may be, but it is a harsh paradise. As the rains clear, we catch up with another character introduced in the first episode, our serval mother that had her den flooded; but she reveals that she has survived. And so has her cub - a miracle under these circumstances.

programme.title: Europe's New Wild
programme.desc: This stunning six-part nature series tells the inspiring story of the rebirthing of the wild regions of the continent of Europe. A land formerly full of diverse wildlife and contrasting landscapes, Europe was in need of special rewilding teams to embark on a mission to return species to their natural habitat and this series focuses on six regions that have benefitted from the project. The Carpathian Mountains of Romania have seen the reintroduction of European bison while rural depopulation in Spain and Portugal offers up the opportunity to expand the wild nature of the Iberian Peninsula. The teams also look at how bears and humans can live peacefully, side by side and explores the myriad creatures that call the Danube Delta home. The unique culture and atmosphere of Lapland plays host to distinctive wildlife and the Sámi people and a natural balance is being restored to the Balkans.

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol
programme.desc: Reality show follows Dutch-born veterinarian Jan Pol, his family and employees' everyday. Jan Pol and his wife Diane started their own practice in Weidman, Michigan, Pol Veterinary Services, back in in 1981. Dr Pol takes a good care of every family pet and head of livestock no matter what size or condition and is a true legend in the community. Dr Pol has seen it all, treating numerous patients every single day, his daily routine is more than 12 hours but nothing can stop him from being devoted to his patients.

programme.title: The Incredible Honey Badger
programme.desc: Honey badgers live a life of fearless confrontation. From the very beginning, they go through nature's ultimate boot camp. These small, curious creatures take stings from scorpions and endure swarms of angry bees—all lessons that strengthen them against far more lethal threats. Over time, they develop an almost supernatural resilience to venom and pain. Honey badgers take on predators many times their size, from lions to leopards. To survive, these resilient animals rely on sharp senses, loose skin, and an unbreakable fighting spirit. Through astonishing footage of real-life confrontations, we see how each brush with death refines the honey badger's fearlessness. Their myth becomes reality as we watch one of nature's toughest living legends and discover what truly makes them so invincible.

programme.title: Born in Africa
programme.desc: Born in Africa is a documentary following the stories of newborns in five animal families in the African savanna, from their first steps to the moment they become independent. These little lions, cheetahs, hyenas, meerkats and jackals must face many challenges along the way, as their mothers do everything to protect them in these most vulnerable stages of life. Watch them as they grow and learn how to move and get by in the wilderness in this intimate portrayal of family dynamics in the natural world.

programme.title: The Casagrandes
programme.desc: Family-orientated cartoon for kids. Ronnie Anne Santiago, her big brother Bobby and their mum have recently moved to Great Lakes City and are now getting used to life in this busy, and sometimes chaotic, new town. Here in the big city they meet the Casagrandes – their extended family made up of grandparents, aunt, uncle, cousins and their pets. Along with a bunch of friends they all live as one big happy family. Skateboarding Ronnie Anne also starts to explore what their new hometown has to offer. Meanwhile, Bobby helps his grandfather Hector working in the family store where they meet lots of interesting characters from the neighbourhood.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: In this crowded and chaotic household, Lincoln Loud is the only boy among his ten sisters. With eleven children under one roof, things get a little bit crazy sometimes, to say the least. This children's cartoon is fun and light-hearted, and Clyde, Lincoln's best friend, only adds to that. Clyde is an only child by contrast, and is jealous of Lincoln's abundance of siblings. Clyde also has a massive crush on Lori, who is Lincoln's oldest sister. However, she has a boyfriend, Bobby. Bobby, although not being particularly intelligent, has several different jobs, ranging from life guard, to security at a shopping centre.

programme.title: The Casagrandes
programme.desc: Family-orientated cartoon for kids. Ronnie Anne Santiago, her big brother Bobby and their mum have recently moved to Great Lakes City and are now getting used to life in this busy, and sometimes chaotic, new town. Here in the big city they meet the Casagrandes – their extended family made up of grandparents, aunt, uncle, cousins and their pets. Along with a bunch of friends they all live as one big happy family. Skateboarding Ronnie Anne also starts to explore what their new hometown has to offer. Meanwhile, Bobby helps his grandfather Hector working in the family store where they meet lots of interesting characters from the neighbourhood.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: In this crowded and chaotic household, Lincoln Loud is the only boy among his ten sisters. With eleven children under one roof, things get a little bit crazy sometimes, to say the least. This children's cartoon is fun and light-hearted, and Clyde, Lincoln's best friend, only adds to that. Clyde is an only child by contrast, and is jealous of Lincoln's abundance of siblings. Clyde also has a massive crush on Lori, who is Lincoln's oldest sister. However, she has a boyfriend, Bobby. Bobby, although not being particularly intelligent, has several different jobs, ranging from life guard, to security at a shopping centre.

programme.desc: Nuts to You/The Terror of Madagascar Description : Nuts to You: Fred the Squirrel has hit the jackpot. He stumbles onto a jackpot oak tree which is loaded with acorns (that's tons of money to animal folk). He's going to need financial advice, and who better to offer sound advice than King Julien? The two enter a partnership looking for ways to spend on the good life. The Red Squirrel has designs on the loot, though, and captures the hapless twosome in order to squeeze the acorns out of them. Will the evil squirrel's precisely planned plot pay or get him played? The Terror of Madagascar: A special delivery has come from Madagascar. What is it? A baby Fossa! Everyone is enchanted by the little tyke except King Julien, who sees him as a lemur-devouring predator, and he has the toothmarks on his butt to prove it! Julien formulates a plan to get rid of the adorable little carnivore, but his slithery solution becomes much worse than the problem!

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: Best Laid Plaintains: It's a special day when Bada and Bing get a shipment of delicious plantains to eat. Although they jealously guard the African bananas, King Julien's determined to taste them too. He sneaks into the gorilla habitat while they sleep, and he and Marlene end up eating a few too many for the gorillas not to notice. Like all of them. When they realize what they've done they head for the hills as fast as their stolen car can take them. Can the penguins calm the savage beasts before they bash the banana bandits? P.E.L.T.: Skipper's losing it. His performance on the obstacle course is actually slowing down, so he has to trigger a special fitness test to prove he can still lead the squad. Kowalski takes over as Skipper excuses himself to go on his fitness quest. The brainy bird appears to do a bang-up job in the leadership role - are Skipper's days at the helm over but he's too chicken to admit it?

programme.title: Potere assoluto
programme.desc: Clint Eastwood dirige e interpreta, al fianco di Gene Hackman, un thriller da antologia. Luther Whitney è un vero artista del furto, nessuna cassaforte o serratura può resistergli, ma ormai sta diventando anziano e ha deciso di ritirarsi dopo un ultimo colpo. Deve però fare i conti con un imprevisto perché la padrona della casa che Luther ha deciso di svaligiare non è partita con il marito, per intrattenersi con il suo amante che non è altri che il Presidente degli Stati Uniti. Quando la donna muore, la polizia prova a insabbiare il caso, ma per farlo occorre far tacere l'unico testimone. Eastwood e Hackman di nuovo uno contro l'altro, come ne "Gli spietati".

Nel 1940, il celebre statista inglese deve affrontare l'avanzata dei nazisti e prendere decisioni drammatiche per il bene del suo paese, ma deve fare i conti con lo scettico re e con alcuni membri del suo partito che sembrano tramare contro di lui. Oscar anche al trucco. La pellicola è stato candidata anche per la sceneggiatura, scritta da Anthony McCarten che aveva firmato anche un altro fortunato biopic, “La teoria del tutto”.

programme.desc: Golden Globe a Whoopi Goldberg nello spettacolare affresco storico di Steven Spielberg. America, anni 20: la storia di una ragazza di colore violentata e trattata come una schiava.

Giunti su un'isola verranno pero' attaccati da una nave americana rischiando di essere schiavizzati ancora. Seconda nomination agli Oscar per Anthony Hopkins nel ruolo di un Presidente degli Stati Uniti (qui interpreta John Q. Adams) dopo quella ottenuta per "Nixon".

programme.title: Blacklight
programme.desc: Liam Neeson e Aidan Quinn in un action Sky Original. Un ex agente federale e una giornalista rischiano la vita per portare alla luce un complotto che coinvolge i vertici dell'FBI.

programme.desc: Scott Eastwood, Orlando Bloom e Milo Gibson in un war movie basato su una storia vera. Afghanistan 2009: 54 soldati americani subiscono l'agguato di centinaia di combattenti talebani.

Durante una rapina qualcuno lo ha tradito, cosi' Will Montgomery si e' fatto qualche anno di carcere. Il bottino non e' mai stato recuperato, ma il suo vecchio socio e' convinto che Will sappia dove sia finito. E per recuperarlo ha un solo modo per convincerlo a collaborare: rapisce sua figlia Allison e la tiene prigioniera nel bagagliaio di un taxi. Se vuole rivedere la ragazza sana e salva, Will deve trovare 10 milioni di dollari in 12 ore.

Ma Cecilia si sente ancora perseguitata e sospetta che il vendicativo e geniale consorte sia una presenza invisibile nella sua vita. A ragione, Griffin ha elaborato un subdolo piano per tornare a terrorizzarla. Scritto e diretto da Leigh Whannell, sceneggiatore di alcuni capitoli della saga di "Saw - L'enigmista'.

Dopo aver commesso un imperdonabile errore, un giovane e ambizioso impiegato di una multinazionale ha la possibilita' di riabilitarsi agli occhi del suo capo e salvare il posto. Ma il boss in realta' lo ricatta, costringendolo a farsi assumere dalla societa' concorrente per rubare il prototipo di un nuovo prodotto. Dalla padella nella brace, si accorgera' di essere la semplice pedina di uno sporco gioco.

Dopo la fine del conflitto Gianni, Antonio e Nicola (Stefano Satta Flores) hanno preso strade diverse: Antonio fa il portantino e Nicola il professore, mentre Gianni è l’unico dei tre che è riuscito a fare carriera. Dopo molti anni, per caso, i tre si incontrano nuovamente. Sceneggiatura dello stesso Scola, con Age & Scarpelli, breve cameo di Vittorio De Sica, scomparso prima dell’uscita del film nelle sale.

programme.desc: Commedia di Marco Martani con Andrea Arcangeli e Alessandra Mastronardi. Assalito dai dubbi prima delle nozze, un ragazzo si risveglia per magia senza la futura sposa al suo fianco.

programme.title: La verità, vi spiego, sull'amore
programme.desc: Ambra Angiolini e Carolina Crescentini nella commedia tratta dal romanzo di Enrica Tesio. Lasciata dal compagno dopo sette anni, una donna tenta di rimettere ordine nella propria vita.

programme.title: Nove lune e mezza
programme.desc: Michela Andreozzi dirige e interpreta una commedia con Claudia Gerini e Giorgio Pasotti. Livia accetta di fungere da madre surrogata per co della sorella, all'insaputa dei rispettivi fidanzati.

programme.title: Lasciarsi un giorno a Roma
programme.desc: Emozionante film Sky Original di e con Edoardo Leo affiancato da Marta Nieto, Claudia Gerini e Stefano Fresi. Due coppie affrontano il momento più delicato della loro lunga vita insieme.

programme.title: Lei mi parla ancora
programme.desc: Pupi Avati dirige Renato Pozzetto e un grande cast nel film Sky Original ispirato al romanzo di Giuseppe Sgarbi. Dopo la morte della moglie, un uomo ripercorre la storia d'amore di una vita.

programme.title: A cena da amici
programme.desc: Dennis Quaid e Andie MacDowell in un film di Norman Jewison sull'autenticità del rapporto di coppia. Il matrimonio di Gabe e Karen entra in crisi quando due loro amici si separano.

programme.title: Lost in Translation - L'amore tradotto
programme.desc: Oscar e Golden Globe a Sofia Coppola per una raffinata commedia romantica con Bill Murray e Scarlett Johansson. A Tokyo per uno spot, un divo americano in declino farà un incontro speciale.

programme.title: Scent of a Woman - Profumo di donna
programme.desc: Oscar ad Al Pacino e 3 Golden Globe per il remake americano di "Profumo di donna". Uno studente accetta di occuparsi di un ex ufficiale cieco e dal carattere impossibile.

programme.title: Prima ti sposo, poi ti rovino
programme.desc: George Clooney e Catherine Zeta-Jones in un'esplosiva commedia romantica dei fratelli Coen. Una donna, che colleziona mariti per denaro, si vendica sposando l'avvocato che l'ha incastrata.

programme.title: Una sirena a Parigi
programme.desc: Marilyn Lima e Nicolas Duvauchelle in una magica avventura su un amore impossibile. Un cantante si prende cura di una sirena ferita, ma cade vittima della sua voce ammaliante.

programme.title: La verità, vi spiego, sull'amore
programme.desc: Ambra Angiolini e Carolina Crescentini nella commedia tratta dal romanzo di Enrica Tesio. Lasciata dal compagno dopo sette anni, una donna tenta di rimettere ordine nella propria vita.

programme.title: Amici, amanti e...
programme.desc: Dal regista di "Ghostbusters" una commedia piccante con due sex symbol di Hollywood, Natalie Portman e Ashton Kutcher. Adam scopre che suo padre (Kevin Kline) ha sedotto la sua fidanzata. Davanti a un simile trauma, il ragazzo si ubriaca e finisce a casa di Emma. I due, amici di lunga data, finiscono a letto insieme e decidono di instaurare una relazione puramente fisica, senza alcun coinvolgimento: ci si diverte ma i sentimenti devono esser tenuti ben lontani. Un reciproco accordo che sembra anche funzionare, ma sara' sempre piu' difficile tenere a bada il cuore...

programme.title: Tutti in piedi
programme.desc: Franck Dubosc e Alexandra Lamy in una commedia romantica. Jocelyn, dongiovanni impenitente, non si ferma davanti a niente quando vuole sedurre una donna. Egoista e bugiardo, finge di essere disabile per conquistare la bella Marie. La messa in scena del playboy si complica pero' quando la donna gli presenta sua sorella Florence, la quale e' costretta veramente a vivere su una sedia a rotelle. Jocelyn dovra' fare i conti con un aspetto da lui sempre trascurato, il sentimento, quello che inizia a provare per Florence. Diretto dallo stesso Franck Dubosc, al suo esordio dietro la macchina da presa.

programme.title: Nessuno mi puo' giudicare
programme.desc: Esilarante commedia di Max Bruno con Paola Cortellesi, Raoul Bova, Rocco Papaleo e Anna Foglietta. Dopo la morte del marito, una donna decide di diventare una escort per pagare i debiti (ITA 2011).

programme.title: Lost in Translation - L'amore tradotto
programme.desc: Oscar e Golden Globe a Sofia Coppola per una raffinata commedia romantica con Bill Murray e Scarlett Johansson. A Tokyo per uno spot, un divo americano in declino farà un incontro speciale.

programme.title: New in Town - Una single in carriera
programme.desc: Commedia sentimentale con Renee Zellweger. Inviata a supervisionare una fabbrica in Minnesota, Lucy supera l'ostilita' della comunita' locale, vivendo un'esperienza ricca di sorprese.

programme.title: Una lunga domenica di passioni
programme.desc: Jean Pierre Jeunet dirige Audrey Tautou in un toccante dramma sentimentale. Una donna affronta gli orrori della Prima Guerra Mondiale per cercare il fidanzato, dato per disperso.

programme.title: Il bacio che aspettavo
programme.desc: Deluso da una donna e salvato dalle donne. Succede ad un aspirante scrittore che rompe con la fidanzata storica e si rifugia insieme al suo cuore infranto nel paese della nonna. Nuovi incontri gli faranno tornare la voglia di innamorarsi.

programme.title: Miller's Girl
programme.desc: Miller's Girl.

programme.title: Se scappi, ti sposo
programme.desc: Julia Roberts e Richard Gere di nuovo insieme nella commedia romantica dal regista di "Pretty Woman". Ike Graham e' un cronista di New York in cerca di un'idea per il prossimo pezzo da consegnare al suo capo, la sua ex moglie. Per caso, in un bar, sente parlare di una donna, Maggie Carpenter, che piu' di una volta ha abbandonato sull'altare i suoi fidanzati. Ike le dedica il suo prossimo articolo, finendo per scatenare l'ira della donna che ne ottiene il licenziamento. Ma Ike non si da' per vinto e decide di fare un viaggio fino nel Maryland per scoprire la verita'.

programme.title: Nessuno mi puo' giudicare
programme.desc: Esilarante commedia di Max Bruno con Paola Cortellesi, Raoul Bova, Rocco Papaleo e Anna Foglietta. Dopo la morte del marito, una donna decide di diventare una escort per pagare i debiti (ITA 2011).

programme.title: A casa tutti bene
programme.desc: Piefrancesco Favino e Stefano Accorsi nel film corale di Gabriele Muccino. Gli equilibri di una famiglia si sfaldano durante un soggiorno forzato su un'isola del Mediterraneo.

programme.title: Victor Victoria
programme.desc: Oscar alla colonna sonora per la commedia di Blake Edwards con Julie Andrews. Parigi, anni 30: una cantante ottiene una scrittura fingendo di essere un uomo che si traveste da donna.

programme.title: Cinquanta sfumature di grigio
programme.desc: Eros e romanticismo per Dakota Johnson e Jamie Dornan, dal romanzo di E. L. James. Una studentessa viene sedotta da un uomo ricco e misterioso, che la coinvolge in un rapporto trasgressivo.

programme.title: L'amore e altre seghe mentali
programme.desc: Commedia romantica di e con Giampaolo Morelli e Maria Chiara Giannetta. Dopo una delusione d'amore Guido è diventato cinico, ma l'incontro con Giulia potrebbe fargli cambiare idea.

programme.title: Miller's Girl
programme.desc: Miller's Girl.

programme.title: Le parole che non ti ho detto
programme.desc: Dal romanzo di Nicholas Sparks, un dramma sentimentale con Kevin Costner, Robin Wright e Paul Newman. Da quando è morta la moglie, Garrett Blake ha perso ogni entusiasmo per la vita. Theresa Osbourne è una giornalista che ha trovato un messaggio in una bottiglia sulla spiaggia, firmato "G". Colpita dalle parole appassionate del testo, si mette sulle tracce di quell'uomo misterioso che affida al mare i suoi messaggi d'amore. Fino in North Carolina, dove vive un costruttore di barche con un doloroso passato da dimenticare.

programme.title: Pane e burlesque
programme.desc: Laura Chiatti e Sabrina Impacciatore in una piccante commedia a tinte rosa. Un paesino del Sud, in crisi e affollato di cassaintegrati dopo la chiusura della fabbrica di ceramiche, viene scosso dall'arrivo di Mimi' la Petite e della sua compagnia di burlesque. Il loro destino si intreccia con quello di Matilde e Teresa, in cerca di un'occasione perche' anche la merceria dove lavorano accusa le difficolta' economiche. Mimi', pero', e' arrivata in citta' anche per un altro motivo: e' infatti la figlia del proprietario della fabbrica e deve vendere le proprieta' di famiglia.

programme.title: Se scappi, ti sposo
programme.desc: Julia Roberts e Richard Gere di nuovo insieme nella commedia romantica dal regista di "Pretty Woman". Ike Graham e' un cronista di New York in cerca di un'idea per il prossimo pezzo da consegnare al suo capo, la sua ex moglie. Per caso, in un bar, sente parlare di una donna, Maggie Carpenter, che piu' di una volta ha abbandonato sull'altare i suoi fidanzati. Ike le dedica il suo prossimo articolo, finendo per scatenare l'ira della donna che ne ottiene il licenziamento. Ma Ike non si da' per vinto e decide di fare un viaggio fino nel Maryland per scoprire la verita'.

programme.title: Il tenente ottomano
programme.desc: L'amore in tempo di guerra in un dramma con Ben Kingsley e Josh Hartnett. Alla vigilia della Grande Guerra, un'infermiera lascia l'America per una missione medica nell'Impero turco.

programme.title: Quel mostro di suocera
programme.desc: Jennifer Lopez e Jane Fonda in una brillante commedia a tinte rosa. Una ragazza sta per sposare l'uomo ideale, ma l'invadente futura suocera farà di tutto per renderle la vita un inferno.

programme.title: Amore a seconda vista
programme.desc: Dal regista di "Famiglia all'improvviso", un'incantevole commedia romantica con Francois Civil e Joséphine Japy. Un famoso romanziere si risveglia in un mondo parallelo e capisce di dover riconquistare Olivia, la donna che ama e che ha già sposato nella sua vita originale.

programme.title: Per tutta la vita
programme.desc: Commedia corale con Luca e Paolo, Ambra Angiolini e Claudia Gerini. Quattro coppie ricevono la notizia che il loro matrimonio e' stato annullato e devono ripresentarsi davanti all'altare.

programme.title: Marilyn ha gli occhi neri
programme.desc: Stefano Accorsi e Miriam Leone in una commedia sentimentale. Come terapia riabilitativa, una bugiarda compulsiva e un uomo irascibile dovranno gestire insieme un ristorante.

programme.title: Il caso Minamata
programme.desc: Johnny Depp nel biopic Sky Original. 1971: il fotografo Eugene Smith indaga sui casi di avvelenamento in un villaggio giapponese, causati dall'inquinamento delle industrie chimiche.

programme.title: A Mistake
programme.desc: Elizabeth Banks in un medical-drama dal romanzo di Carl Shuker. La dottoressa Taylor è un rinomato chirurgo che commette un fatale errore durante un'operazione di routine. Isolata dai vertici dell'ospedale, affronta il tracollo della sua vita professionale e privata.

programme.title: Red Joan
programme.desc: Judi Dench nella storia di una spia del KGB. Sottoposta a interrogatorio, l'insospettabile vedova Joan Stanley ripercorre la sua lunga militanza al servizio del regime comunista.

programme.title: La pazza gioia
programme.desc: Valeria Bruni Tedeschi e Micaela Ramazzotti nel road movie al femminile di Paolo Virzì. Due donne fuggono da una clinica psichiatrica e si avventurano a riassaporare il mondo.

programme.title: Campo di battaglia
programme.desc: Alessandro Borghi e Gabriel Montesi nel film di Gianni Amelio. Durante la Grande Guerra e l’epidemia di febbre spagnola l’amicizia tra 2 medici è minata dal diverso approccio etico.

programme.title: Fuga in Normandia
programme.desc: Da una storia vera, l'ultimo film per Michael Caine prima del suo ritiro dalle scene e per l'indimenticabile Glenda Jackson. L'anziano Bernie fugge dall'ospizio per raggiungere la Francia e celebrare con gli altri veterani il 70esimo anniversario dello sbarco in Normandia.

programme.title: Berlinguer - La grande ambizione
programme.desc: Elio Germano, diretto da Andrea Segre, nel biopic su uno dei grandi protagonisti della Prima Repubblica. Il film rilegge un pezzo della nostra storia, e sullo sfondo degli anni 70 ripercorre la vita privata e la militanza politica del leader del Partito Comunista Italiano.

programme.title: Dogman (2018)
programme.desc: Marcello Fonte, premiato a Cannes, ed Edoardo Pesce nel film di Matteo Garrone ispirato a un fatto di cronaca. Periferia di Roma: un mite toelettatore reagisce ai soprusi del suo aguzzino.

programme.title: Elizabeth
programme.desc: Oscar e Golden Globe al pluiripremiato film sulla biografia di Elisabetta I d'Inghilterra, con Cate Blanchett e Geoffrey Rush. La storia della regina che fece della sua nazione una potenza.

programme.title: Tornare
programme.desc: Cristina Comencini dirige Giovanna Mezzogiorno in un dramma psicologico. Alice torna in Italia per il funerale di suo padre e viene travolta dai ricordi della propria giovinezza.

programme.title: La vita immortale di Henrietta Lacks
programme.desc: Dal libro di Rebecca Skloot, un film HBO con Oprah Winfrey. Nel 1951 un'inchiesta fa luce sulle incredibili scoperte mediche ottenute dall'utilizzo non autorizzato di cellule tumorali.

programme.title: Dall'alto di una fredda torre
programme.desc: Edoardo Pesce e Vanessa Scalera in una toccante pellicola. La normalita' di una famiglia viene spezzata quando si scopre che entrambi i genitori sono malati e solo uno puo' essere salvato.

programme.title: Il professore e il pazzo
programme.desc: Mel Gibson e Sean Penn nel resoconto di una storica impresa. 1879: per redigere il primo dizionario di inglese, un accademico di Oxford riceve l'aiuto di un reduce rinchiuso in manicomio.

programme.title: 18 regali
programme.desc: Ispirato a una storia vera, Francesco Amato dirige Vittoria Puccini, Benedetta Porcaroli ed Edoardo Leo. Una donna incinta reagisce a un destino crudele con un’idea speciale per sua figlia.

programme.title: Una vita tranquilla
programme.desc: Claudio Cupellini dirige Marco D'Amore e Toni Servillo, premiato a Roma. In fuga dall'Italia, Rosario cambia identità e si trasferisce in Germania, ma il passato bussa alla sua porta.

programme.title: Dogman (2018)
programme.desc: Marcello Fonte, premiato a Cannes, ed Edoardo Pesce nel film di Matteo Garrone ispirato a un fatto di cronaca. Periferia di Roma: un mite toelettatore reagisce ai soprusi del suo aguzzino.

programme.title: Attacco a Mumbai - Una vera storia di coraggio
programme.desc: L’inferno del terrorismo in un infuocato dramma tratto da una storia vera, con Armie Hammer e Dev Patel. Nel novembre 2008 un gruppo di jihadisti armati sbarca a Mumbai per compiere una serie di attentati in vari punti della città e prendere d’assalto un storico albergo di lusso.

programme.title: Colette
programme.desc: Keira Knightley nel biopic sulla scrittrice Gabrielle Sidonie Colette. Protagonista della scena artistica nella Parigi della Belle Epoque, divenne un modello di emancipazione femminile.

programme.title: Il mio amico Einstein
programme.desc: Biopic su Albert Einstein con Andy Serkis. Sullo sfondo della Prima guerra mondiale, le teorie dello scienziato tedesco colpiscono l'immaginazione di un fisico di Cambridge.

programme.title: Spencer
programme.desc: Biopic con Kristen Stewart nei panni della Principessa Diana. Natale 1991: nella tenuta reale di Sandringham, Lady D. matura la decisione di interrompere il matrimonio con Carlo.

programme.title: The Judge
programme.desc: Robert Downey Jr. e Robert Duvall in un’intensa storia familiare. Un avvocato torna nella sua cittadina natale e scopre che il padre, un anziano giudice, è stato accusato di omicidio.

programme.title: La paranza dei bambini
programme.desc: Miglior sceneggiatura a Berlino 2019 per il film di Claudio Giovannesi tratto dal bestseller di Roberto Saviano. Napoli: l'ascesa di un gruppo di giovanissimi nel mondo della criminalita'.

programme.title: La zona d'interesse
programme.desc: Premio a Cannes e 2 Oscar per l'intensa opera di Jonathan Glazer. Un solo muro separa la quiete borghese della famiglia del comandante di Auschwitz dal campo di concentramento.

programme.title: Attacco a Mumbai - Una vera storia di coraggio
programme.desc: L’inferno del terrorismo in un infuocato dramma tratto da una storia vera, con Armie Hammer e Dev Patel. Nel novembre 2008 un gruppo di jihadisti armati sbarca a Mumbai per compiere una serie di attentati in vari punti della città e prendere d’assalto un storico albergo di lusso.

programme.title: Gli indifferenti
programme.desc: Valeria Bruni Tedeschi, Edoardo Pesce e Giovanna Mezzogiorno nell'adattamento del romanzo di Alberto Moravia. Intrighi e sentimenti morbosi si consumano in una famiglia romana in declino.

programme.title: You Don't Know Jack - Il dottor Morte
programme.desc: Al Pacino nel biopic targato HBO diretto da Barry Levinson. La scioccante storia di Jack Kevorkian, il medico statunitense che praticò il suicidio assistito su decine di malati terminali.

programme.title: Gli ultimi saranno ultimi
programme.desc: Dramma sociale di Massimiliano Bruno con Paola Cortellesi e Alessandro Gassmann. La vita di una donna, licenziata perche' incinta, si intreccia con quella di un poliziotto tormentato.

programme.title: Spencer
programme.desc: Biopic con Kristen Stewart nei panni della Principessa Diana. Natale 1991: nella tenuta reale di Sandringham, Lady D. matura la decisione di interrompere il matrimonio con Carlo.

programme.title: Veloce come il vento
programme.desc: Matteo Rovere dirige Stefano Accorsi e Matilda De Angelis. Dopo la morte del padre, una ragazza appassionata di motori ritrova suo fratello, pilota provetto diventato tossicodipendente.

programme.title: The Judge
programme.desc: Robert Downey Jr. e Robert Duvall in un’intensa storia familiare. Un avvocato torna nella sua cittadina natale e scopre che il padre, un anziano giudice, è stato accusato di omicidio.

programme.title: Bleed - Più forte del destino
programme.desc: Miles Teller nell'esaltante storia del pugile Vinny Pazienza. Reduce da un terribile incidente, il tenace campione non si arrende e torna sul ring per combattere un match leggendario.

programme.title: Mi chiamo Francesco Totti
programme.desc: Francesco Totti si racconta nel documentario di Alex Infascelli. Nella notte che precede l'addio al calcio, il capitano della Roma ripercorre le emozioni della sua vita privata e sportiva.

programme.title: Eyes Wide Shut
programme.desc: Nicole Kidman e Tom Cruise nell'ultimo capolavoro di Stanley Kubrick che scava nell'intimità di una coppia. Un uomo perde ogni certezza quando la moglie gli svela i suoi sogni proibiti.

programme.title: Ghiaccio
programme.desc: Fabrizio Moro debutta alla regia con Alessio De Leonardis in un film con Giacomo Ferrara e Vinicio Marchioni. Roma: un ragazzo di borgata cerca nella boxe il riscatto da una vita difficile.

programme.title: American Skin
programme.desc: Nate Parker dirige e interpreta il film Sky Original sulle diseguaglianze razziali. Un padre afroamericano cerca giustizia per il figlio ucciso da un poliziotto durante un controllo.

programme.title: La nostra storia
programme.desc: Javier Camara nel racconto di una famiglia e della Colombia degli anni 70 e 80. Tornato a Medellin, Hector evoca la figura del padre, medico e attivista inviso al regime paramilitare.

programme.title: After Yang
programme.desc: Colin Farrell nel film targato Sky Original, premiato al Sundance Festival. Nel futuro, i membri di una famiglia devono fare i conti con il malfunzionamento dell'androide che vive con loro.

programme.title: Il meglio deve ancora venire
programme.desc: Dagli autori di "Cena tra amici", un inno all'amicizia con Fabrice Luchini e Patrick Bruel. Per un macabro equivoco, Arthur e Cesar decidono di godersi quel che resta del loro futuro.

programme.title: Bleed - Più forte del destino
programme.desc: Miles Teller nell'esaltante storia del pugile Vinny Pazienza. Reduce da un terribile incidente, il tenace campione non si arrende e torna sul ring per combattere un match leggendario.

programme.title: Questo o quello: Speciale
programme.desc: Gli esperti di Sky Cinema, Francesco Castelnuovo e Gianni Canova, analizzano e mettono a confronto due film in programmazione sui canali Sky a puntata, per un confronto ricco di approfondimenti.

programme.title: Conspiracy - Soluzione finale
programme.desc: Kenneth Branagh e Stanley Tucci in un film premiato con 2 Emmy e 1 Golden Globe. 1942: i leader nazisti si riuniscono nei pressi di Berlino per pianificare lo sterminio degli ebrei.

programme.title: Qui rido io
programme.desc: Toni Servillo interpreta Eduardo Scarpetta nel biopic di Mario Martone premiato con 2 David di Donatello 2022. La storia dell'attore napoletano da cui sono nati i tre fratelli De Filippo.

programme.title: Maria Regina di Scozia
programme.desc: Saoirse Ronan e Margot Robbie in un biopic alla corte d'Inghilterra. Maria Stuarda lascia la corona di Francia e torna in patria per rivendicare il trono su cui siede Elisabetta I.

programme.title: Itaca. Il Ritorno
programme.desc: Il poema omerico nella rilettura di Uberto Pasolini che mette in scena il ritorno di Ulisse nella sua Itaca dopo 20 anni di lontananza, ma il suo regno è profondamente cambiato ed è minacciato dai Proci.

programme.title: Habemus Papam
programme.desc: Nanni Moretti dirige e interpreta, con Michel Piccoli e Margherita Buy, una pellicola su un'inaspettata crisi esistenziale. Il nuovo Papa, assalito dall'ansia, rinuncia alla sua missione.

programme.title: Beautiful Minds
programme.desc: Il valore dell'amicizia in un film on the road. Due uomini, soli e molto diversi, si ritrovano a viaggiare su un carro funebre verso il sud della Francia con una nuova leggerezza nel cuore.

programme.title: Horizon: An American Saga - Capitolo 1
programme.desc: Primo capitolo della saga western scritta, diretta e interpretata da Kevin Costner. A cavallo della Guerra civile americana si consuma lo scontro tra pionieri e nativi americani.

programme.title: Il meglio deve ancora venire
programme.desc: Dagli autori di "Cena tra amici", un inno all'amicizia con Fabrice Luchini e Patrick Bruel. Per un macabro equivoco, Arthur e Cesar decidono di godersi quel che resta del loro futuro.

programme.title: Io e Angela
programme.desc: Commedia noir di Herbert Simone Paragnani con Ilenia Pastorelli e Pietro Sermonti. Un uomo riceve la visita dell’Angelo della Morte, una donna seducente che gli mostra le impurità della sua vita. Il loro accordo si rivelerà pericoloso per entrambi.

programme.title: Io sono Tempesta
programme.desc: Marco Giallini ed Elio Germano in una pellicola di Daniele Luchetti. Un affarista senza scrupoli viene condannato ai servizi sociali, dove conosce un padre in gravi difficolta' economiche.

programme.title: Baywatch
programme.desc: Dwayne Johnson e Zac Efron nell'action comedy ispirata alla serie tv anni '90. Mitch e il suo team di bagnini devono sgominare una pericolosa banda di trafficanti di droga.

programme.title: Se mi lasci non vale
programme.desc: Vincenzo Salemme dirige e interpreta una commedia con Carlo Buccirosso. Lasciati dalle fidanzate, due uomini elaborano un piano diabolico con l'aiuto di un attore squattrinato.

programme.title: Vacanze ai Caraibi
programme.desc: Commedia a episodi di Neri Parenti guidata da Christian De Sica. Due coniugi in balia delle scelte della figlia; la passione di una coppia poco compatibile; un uomo su un'isola senza wi-fi.

programme.title: Un fantastico via vai
programme.desc: Leonardo Pieraccioni nel mondo dei 'laureati' in una commedia con Serena Autieri. Cacciato dalla moglie, un quarantenne si ritrova a condividere un appartamento con quattro studenti.

programme.title: Figli
programme.desc: Grande successo Vision Distribution con Paola Cortellesi e Valerio Mastandrea, tratto dal monologo di Mattia Torre sulla quotidiana lotta delle coppie che crescono piu' di un figlio.

programme.title: Il premio
programme.desc: Alessandro Gassmann dirige e interpreta una commedia con Gigi Proietti, Rocco Papaleo, Anna Foglietta. Uno scrittore con la paura di volare raggiunge Stoccolma in auto per ritirare il Nobel.

programme.title: Sono tornato
programme.desc: Massimo Popolizio e Frank Matano nella commedia diretta da Luca Miniero. Nell'Italia di oggi fa la sua comparsa il vero Benito Mussolini, che vuole riconquistare il paese...

programme.title: Cinquanta sbavature di nero
programme.desc: Dai produttori di "Ghost Movie" la parodia del film campione di incassi. Una timida studentessa incontra il milionario Christian Black e si lascia guidare nel suo mondo di vizi e stranezze.

programme.title: Questo o quello: Speciale

programme.desc: Una squadra di comici, capitanati da Christian De Sica ed Enrico Brignano, per una commedia sull'Italia di oggi. I Tucci sono una numerosa famiglia di un paesino laziale. Da sempre poveri, vincono 100 milioni alla lotteria e la loro vita si trasforma. Per non far sapere di essere i fortunati possessori del biglietto, si trasferiscono in un lussuoso hotel milanese dando vita a un'escalation di risate e a una serie di situazioni paradossali. Diretto da Fausto Brizzi, il film e' un remake di "Les Tuche", grande successo in Francia. Gustoso cameo di Al Bano. Nel cast la grande Anna Mazzamauro.

Decidono quindi di attraversare gli Stati Uniti con la speranza di rintracciare l'uomo. Ma per farlo dovranno ascoltare tutte le avventure sessuali vissute dalla focosa e libertina Helen nei disinibiti anni Settanta. Nel cast i premi Oscar J.K. Simmons e Christopher Walken.

programme.title: One World: Friday, November 28, 2025 12pm ET/Marketplace Africa: Nigeria E1 Boat Racing/Developing Nigeria's Waterways; Samer Kassem
programme.desc: Zain Asher and Bianna Golodryga cover the top global and national issues of the day./In Lagos Nigeria, 17% of the state is composed of waterways and lagoons. But water transportation is highly underutilized, despite poor road infrastructure and traffic congestion. Now, the state actively seeking to develop its waterways network through public ferries and private operators as well as a partnership with the international boat racing franchise E1, with the first African E1 event taking place in October. E1 is also looking to grow their presence on the continent through digital education and outreach, something that is launching in tandem with the event in October. We take a look at the challenges and opportunities of developing Lagos' waterways, and the potential economic boost of tapping into the region's blue economy. Also, Aspen Global CEO Samer Kassem sits down to discuss the biopharmaceutical giant's growth strategy and the markets he believes will grow in the coming years.

programme.title: All Hail King Julien

programme.title: Dawn Of The Croods

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Paws Of Destiny
programme.desc: Po, the kids, and the new Panda Guardians must work together to defeat Jindiao once and for all, and get a visit from an unlikely source.

programme.title: The Adventures Of Puss In Boots
programme.desc: When Puss feels powerless against the threat of the Bloodwolf, the crew asks Callista to help find the mysterious location of the Obelisk of Night.

programme.title: Dinotrux
programme.desc: Garby and Click-Clack must rescue the Dinotruxafter they are tied down by a destructive tribe of Slamtools who made an evil deal with D-Structs.

programme.title: Dinotrux
programme.desc: Dozer and the crew must find a way to outsmart a clever bully named Blayde, a new ememy who kidnapped George and destroyed the Dozeratop mounds.

programme.title: Turbo F.A.S.T.
programme.desc: A group of fire ants swarm the city and it's up to Burn to race their leader in order to get them to leave. However, a worried Chet gets in the way. // The crew travels to Mississippi for a race in the swamp. When Skidmark goes missing, they fear he has been taken by a creepy mythological creature.

programme.title: Turbo F.A.S.T.
programme.desc: On the day Turbo unveils a new cologne he has created, birds suddenly start attacking the city and it's up to the crew to figure out how to get rid of the feathery menaces before anyone gets eaten/Travelling through the desert to visit a kid snail who is sick, the crew runs afoul of a villainous sheriff who puts them in jail until Turbo agrees to throw a race.

programme.title: Where's Wally?
programme.desc: Odlulu wants her own quinceañera, a traditional Mexican celebration for a girl's 15th birthday, so she uses the Grow-Up Key to skip ahead a few years. But the key backfires and turns her into a toddler! Fritz must babysit Toddler Odlulu as she wanders through Mexico City, all while Wally and Wenda try to retrieve the Grow-Up Key and get Odlulu back to her normal age.

programme.title: Where's Wally?
programme.desc: The Wanderers receive a WanderPost with some odd news from paleontologist, WIZARD AMBER: living dinosaurs are roaming around Mongolia! Odlulu and Fritz are using the DINO KEY to get the ultimate pets: real dinosaurs! So Wally and Wenda must use their dino-knowledge to wrangle these prehistoric animals before they overrun all of Mongolia.

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective
programme.desc: Queen Sparklewings has done a beautiful painting to use in her Story-Time afternoon. But then Coco and Noddy discover it ruined! Coco thinks that Bling must have done it but she protests her innocence. Noddy investigates: who messed up the Queen's painting - and can he get it fixed again in time? Keep investigating, Noddy!

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective
programme.desc: \"Deltoid accepts the Ninja's challenge to run around the loop-theloop. But when he fails on his first attempt, he feels ready to give up in despair. Noddy investigates: How can he help Deltoid do his challenge?\".

programme.title: Roary The Racing Car
programme.desc: Mr Carburettor is planning a big firework display up at the farm. Can Roary help Tin Top overcome his fear of bangs in time for the display?

programme.title: Roary The Racing Car
programme.desc: Mr Carburettor has demanded pizza for lunch but the pizzeria is closed. How is Marsha going to ensure Mr Carburettor gets the lunch he asked for?

programme.title: Tinga Tinga Tales
programme.desc: You see there was a time when Warthog was really rather handsome. And did he know it! He strutted around Tinga Tinga as if he owned the place. All the animals were fed up with Warthog's boasting, and then one day Lion decided to give chase. Yikes! Warthog ran headfirst into Porcupines burrow! After that, he was no longer the prettiest beast in Tinga Tinga. Tales from Africa.

programme.title: CSI S4 E06 - Jackpot
programme.desc: Season 4 begins with terrific back-to-back episodes involving serial killers (\"Assume Nothing\" / \"For All Our Country\"). There's a new politically minded sheriff in town and in \"Invisible Evidence\" he's ticked off that the CSI's can't get enough evidence to convict a rapist/murderer. Also, Nick and Sara buck for the same promotion. Along the way there are plenty of quirky cases: one involving a museum robbery (\"Suckers\") and one involving a dead juror (\"Eleven Angry Jurors\"). Grissom travels to a small town with plenty of secrets to solve a murder in \"Jackpot,\" Catherine dates a younger man in \"Early Rollout,\" and Sara works a case involving a woman strikingly similar to herself in \"Butterflied.\" There's also plenty of kinkiness in \"Fur and Loathing\" and tragedy \"Bad Words.\".

programme.title: Sari Saring Sine: Hindi Pa Tapos ang Laban
programme.desc: Fernando Poe Jr. stars as Carding Villamar, a city professional who returns to their hometown of Evangelista after learning of his brother's untimely demise. As a series of events unfold, he soon discovers that his brother didn't succumb to a heart attack as he was made to believe. He was shot in cold blood for refusing to sell his land to a powerful congressman. With a town muted and crippled by fear, the congressman's henchmen move unhampered to silence Carding and his brother's orphaned family as well. Big mistake. Armed with only a crusty riffle and a whole ton of rage. Carding sets out to right the wrong and exact vengeance for the murder of his brother. That is, if he survives the hot pursuits of bounty hunters, the militia and the police who are all in the congressman's payroll.

Just when she thought her life is finally back to normal, her greatest love comes back, determined to work for her forgiveness and win her back—even if it means breaking her family apart.

programme.title: The Mysterious Case of Bea Montenegro ep 1
programme.desc: A Sari-Sari Original Series. Hot off the heels from her last cold case, investigative journalist Christine Del Mundo (Maui Taylor) is back with a brand new cold case. This time, it involves actress Bea Montenegro, whose death has only brought forth one suspect - a fellow model who suffers from face blindness.

programme.title: Afterlife ep 7
programme.desc: Peter, a deceased Filipino-Chinese businessman, returns as a ghost and is bonded to Romy, a Filipino caretaker of a Chinese temple. He sets out to let his family know the whole truth through Romy.

programme.title: Da Pers Family ep 28
programme.desc:
A story of a couple who preserves the family 
bakery business legacy from closure. Now the 
couple’s children, volunteers to step in and help the 
business. Are the parents willing to accept change

programme.title: Sari Saring Sine: Hindi Pa Tapos ang Laban
programme.desc: Fernando Poe Jr. stars as Carding Villamar, a city professional who returns to their hometown of Evangelista after learning of his brother's untimely demise. As a series of events unfold, he soon discovers that his brother didn't succumb to a heart attack as he was made to believe. He was shot in cold blood for refusing to sell his land to a powerful congressman. With a town muted and crippled by fear, the congressman's henchmen move unhampered to silence Carding and his brother's orphaned family as well. Big mistake. Armed with only a crusty riffle and a whole ton of rage. Carding sets out to right the wrong and exact vengeance for the murder of his brother. That is, if he survives the hot pursuits of bounty hunters, the militia and the police who are all in the congressman's payroll.

programme.title: From the Beautiful Country ep 1
programme.desc: A Sari-Sari original series. Four beauty pageant contestants find themselves prime suspects when another contestant winds up dead. Each girl has her motive, but which one of them did it? And which one will end up with the crown?

programme.title: Carpool ep 3
programme.desc: Carpool' revolves around four individuals whose lives get thrown into chaos after sharing a carpool ride which ended up in a tragic accident. A streak of unfortunate events seemingly taking them down.

programme.title: Kurdapya ep 10
programme.desc: Kurdapya tells the story of long-lost twins, KURING \u0026 DAPHNE. They meet after a strange accident and discover that they lead extremely different lives. Kuring grew up with the cruel extended family in the province while Daphne is an undervalued publishing executive in the city. Both women want to get out of their current realities, so they decide to switch lives by pretending to be each other.

programme.title: Clash Of The Titans
programme.desc: In CLASH OF THE TITANS, the ultimate struggle for power pits men against kings and kings against gods. But the war between the gods themselves could destroy the world. Sam Worthington (Terminator Salvation, Avatar) stars as the Greek hero Perseus in this spectacular retelling of the classic myth (and '80s cult classic film). Born of a god, but raised as a man, Perseus is helpless to save his family from the clutches of Hades (Oscar nominee Ralph Fiennes -- Harry Potter films), the vengeful god of the underworld. With nothing left to lose, he volunteers to lead a dangerous mission to defeat Hades before he can seize power from Zeus (Oscar nominee Liam Neeson -- Batman Begins) and unleash hell on earth. With a daring band of warriors, Perseus sets off on a perilous journey deep into forbidden worlds. Battling unholy demons and fearsome beasts, he will triumph only if he can accept his power as a god, defy his fate and create his own destiny.

programme.desc: A deadly bin puts all the buyers on edge. It's a bad omen that casts a dark shadow over the day. As the day winds to a fever pitch, Brandon and Lori square off against Scott and Chrissy in a do or die bidding war that sends all strategy out the window. And later, our competitors uncover a high-tech find they think could worth thousands. But all that glitters may not be gold.

And later, it's every man for himself when a unit full of gemstones ignites an all out war among the competition.

If his secret stays safe, he could quadruple his profit.

programme.title: Blood Diamond
programme.desc: Academy Award nominees Leonardo DiCaprio and Djimon Hounsou join Academy Award winner Jennifer Connelly in this action drama from Ed Zwick, the filmmaker behind The Last Samurai. DiCaprio stars as Danny Archer, a mercenary smuggler searching for a priceless diamond amid the chaos of Sierra Leone's civil war; Hounsou (Gladiator), as a desperate father searching for his lost son; and Connelly (A Beautiful Mind), as a reporter searching for the truth behind the trade in 'conflict diamonds.' Forced to confront the brutal human cost of the diamond trade, Archer changes his search for financial reward to a quest for redemption.

programme.title: Mad Max
programme.desc: Taking place in a dystopian Australia in the near future, Mad Max tells the story of a highway patrolman cruising the squalid back roads that have become the breeding ground of criminals foraging for gasoline and scraps. When his wife and child meet a grisly end at the hands of a motorcycle gang, Max sets out across the barren wastelands in search of revenge. Written by Cole Matthews.

programme.title: Giant
programme.desc: Wealthy rancher Bick Benedict (Hudson) and dirt-poor cowboy Jett Rink (Dean) both woo Leslie Lynnton (Taylor) a beautiful young woman from Maryland who is new to Texas. She marries Benedict, but she is shocked by the racial bigotry of the White Texans against the local people of Mexican descent. Rink discovers oil on a small plot of land, and while he uses his vast, new wealth to buy all the land surrounding the Benedict ranch, the Benedict's disagreement over prejudice fuels conflict the runs across generations.

programme.title: Shazam!
programme.desc: We all have a superhero inside us, it just takes a bit of magic to bring it out. In Billy Batson’s (Asher Angel) case, by shouting out one word—SHAZAM!—this streetwise 14-year-old foster kid can turn into the adult Super Hero Shazam (Zachary Levi), courtesy of an ancient wizard (Djimon Hounsou). Still a kid at heart—inside a ripped, godlike body—Shazam revels in this adult version of himself by doing what any teen would do with superpowers: have fun with them! Can he fly? Does he have X-ray vision? Can he shoot lightning out of his hands? Can he skip his social studies test? Shazam sets out to test the limits of his abilities with the joyful recklessness of a child. But he’ll need to master these powers quickly in order to fight the deadly forces of evil controlled by Dr. Thaddeus Sivana (Mark Strong).

The Demon Girl Next Door
programme.sub-title: Just How Sporty Are You!? Everything Is Fluctuating
programme.desc: Yuko challenges Momo to a battle during the weekend, which ends up turning into an all-day running session; another demon girl prepares to set Yuko back on the right path.

programme.title: The Demon Girl Next Door
programme.sub-title: Nightmare or Forebear?! The Doorstop of Darkness Descends
programme.desc: Yuko's demon ancestor Lilith appears in her dream to give her some advice, only for her to forget everything she said when she wakes up.

programme.title: The Demon Girl Next Door
programme.sub-title: Sharpen Your Mind!! The Newly Awakened Powers of the Magical Girl
programme.desc: Momo discovers a switch on the bottom of the statue that Yuko carries around; upon being flipped, it gives Lilith the opportunity to possess Yuko's body.

programme.title: The Demon Girl Next Door
programme.sub-title: A Town Full of Traps?? The Demon on the Brink Awakens a New Ability
programme.desc: Yuko buys a camera with the money she was going to use to pay off her debt.

programme.title: The Demon Girl Next Door
programme.sub-title: Courage to Face the Future!! The Heavy Roller Won't Stop
programme.desc: Lilith sends Yuko into Momo's subconscious, where she ends up tidying the dark muck surrounding her dreams.

programme.title: The Demon Girl Next Door
programme.sub-title: The Pink Method!! The Wheel of Fate is a Round Tire!!
programme.desc: The Yoshida family celebrate by holding an okonomiyaki party after discovering that Yuko's actions have lifted the curse limiting their family to a tight monthly budget.

programme.title: The Demon Girl Next Door
programme.sub-title: The Cursed Fruit!! Beware the Sour Mikan!!
programme.desc: The magical girl, Mikan Hinatsuki, is called by Momo to assist her with Yuko's training; Yuko learns that magical girls disappear if they use up all of their magic.

programme.title: The Demon Girl Next Door
programme.sub-title: Final Exams!! Today I'm One of Those Brainy Demons!!
programme.desc: Wanting Momo to take her more seriously, Yuko proposes a friendly duel to determine who can score best on history during the final exams.

programme.title: The Demon Girl Next Door
programme.sub-title: The Ancestor Evolves!! A Pair of Glasses Reflect Within a Dark Lab
programme.desc: Yuko's occult-obsessed classmate, Sion Ogura, brings her and Momo to the Black Magic Studies Lab to try some experiments on Lilith's statue.

programme.title: The Demon Girl Next Door
programme.sub-title: Diving into Dreams Once Again!! Break Through the Pink Defense Line
programme.desc: Wanting to get Momo to open up to her, Yuko once again dives into her dream; this time she has to break through her outer defenses.

programme.title: The Demon Girl Next Door
programme.sub-title: Feelings to Convey!! A New Leap Forward for Demonkind!!
programme.desc: Chasing after Momo after she runs off, Yuko proposes that she quit being a magical girl and become her vassal so she can search for Sakura.

programme.title: The Demon Girl Next Door 2
programme.sub-title: Yet Another Showdown! The Magical Girl has a Brand New Appearance?!
programme.desc: Challenging an archnemesis to a duel can be awkward if they mistake it as an invitation to hang out.

programme.title: The Demon Girl Next Door 2
programme.sub-title: Urban Exploration! The Troubled Mikan and the Excited Demon
programme.desc: Mikan recognizes the box that seals Shamiko's dad; the factory ruins on the outskirts of town may hold clues about Momo's sister.

programme.title: The Demon Girl Next Door 2
programme.sub-title: The Dark Witch Returns! With Steam From Hell!
programme.desc: After hearing that Lilith has been sealed away for over 2000 years, Shamiko and Momo come up with a plan to let her borrow Shamiko's body and enjoy a day of freedom.

programme.title: The Demon Girl Next Door 2
programme.sub-title: A New Species Discovered! The Town Cafe Is a Demon Lair!
programme.desc: Shamiko visits a cafe rumored to be frequented by demons in search of clues about Sakura; Shamiko ends up getting a part-time job.

programme.title: The Demon Girl Next Door 2
programme.sub-title: Raid! The Pink Plan to Retake Shamiko!
programme.desc: Shamiko learns that Lico and Shirosawa have a connection to Sakura and decides to continue working part-time at the cafe; Momo is vehemently opposed to Shamiko's job.

programme.title: The Demon Girl Next Door 2
programme.sub-title: Vow Under the Setting Sun! The Path Forward for Demonkind!
programme.desc: When Shamiko finds herself in trouble, the one who saves her is none other than Sakura Chiyoda; Momo takes action to save Shamiko from her nightmare.

programme.title: The Demon Girl Next Door 2
programme.sub-title: A Short Break!! The Demonic Summer Festival
programme.desc: Shamiko's summer vacation has turned out to be hectic; she tries to reclaim some peace in her life, but the looming stack of homework casts a dark shadow.

programme.title: The Demon Girl Next Door 2
programme.sub-title: Sparks Fly?! Light and Dark Go on a Joint Excursion!
programme.desc: Shamiko promises to visit the zoo with Momo and Mikan and tries making boxed lunches for them; Shamiko needs help to make something tasty, so she visits a certain address.

programme.title: The Demon Girl Next Door 2
programme.sub-title: Pitch Black Feelings!! Darkness Peach Returns!!
programme.desc: Momo is stuck in her darkness form; without the ability to control her strength, Momo unintentionally destroys everything she touches.

programme.title: The Demon Girl Next Door 2
programme.sub-title: The Ancestor's Dojo?! Demonkind's Ultimate Weapon
programme.desc: Shamiko can't use her magic rod right because of a lack of imagination; she undergoes special training in Lilith's sealed space.

programme.title: The Demon Girl Next Door 2
programme.sub-title: New Semester! The Magical Girl's New Duty!
programme.desc: A chaotic summer break ends and a new school semester begins; Mikan transfers into Shamiko's class.

programme.title: The Demon Girl Next Door 2
programme.sub-title: A Ritual in Darkness! The Demon's New Ally!!
programme.desc: Shamiko and Momo enter Mikan's heart to negotiate with Ugallu, the entity responsible for the magical girl's curse.

programme.title: Urusei Yatsura
programme.sub-title: Young Love on the Run; Between a Rock and a Hard Place
programme.desc: The fate of the world rests with a skirt-chasing teenager called Ataru Moroboshi; a love-struck Oni alien princess Lum comes between Ataru and Shinobu.

programme.title: Urusei Yatsura
programme.sub-title: Present for You; The Yellow Ribbon of Happiness
programme.desc: Sakura's crazy exorcism ritual does Ataru more harm than good; Ataru gets more than he bargained for when he uses power-dampening yellow ribbons on Lum.

programme.title: Urusei Yatsura
programme.sub-title: Trouble Rains Down!!; Amazed in a Maze
programme.desc: Shutaro becomes the apple of every girl's eye and, by extension, a prick to every boy; Lum, Ataru, Shinobu and Shutaro struggle to find a way out of a labyrinthine cave.

programme.title: Urusei Yatsura
programme.desc: Ataru and Shutaro emerge as potential mates for the crow aliens' very own sleeping beauty. While one steals the customary kiss, the other captures her heart simply by being in the right place at the right time.

programme.title: Spider-Man
programme.desc: Peter Parker's life changes when he is bitten by a genetically altered spider and gains superpowers. He uses his powers to help people and finds himself facing the Green Goblin, an evil maniac.

programme.title: RoboCop
programme.desc: Detective Alex Murphy is on the brink of death after being critically injured in a bomb blast. However, a technology company transforms him into RoboCop, a one-of-a-kind cyborg police officer.

programme.title: The Transporter Refueled
programme.desc: Frank Martin, a former mercenary, is hired by a woman and her accomplices to fulfil a contract. Soon, however, he must join forces with them to bring down a Russian crime lord.

programme.title: The Kidnapping of Freddy Heineken
programme.desc: A gang of childhood friends make a plan to abduct one of the richest men on the earth and demand the largest ransom ever paid for any kidnapping.

programme.title: 3 Days to Kill
programme.desc: After being diagnosed with a terminal illness, spy Ethan Renner decides to give up his career. While looking after his teenage daughter, he must finish his final mission of catching a terrorist.

programme.title: Street Kings
programme.desc: After his wife's death, Detective Tom Ludlow casts aside all rules and becomes a murder suspect. He begins questioning his colleagues' loyalties and sets out to prove his innocence.

programme.title: Take Shelter
programme.desc: Plagued by nightmares, Curtis builds a storm shelter, acting on visions that jeopardise his family's stability and harmony.

programme.title: Snowpiercer
programme.desc: New power dynamics emerge amongst the survivors of the second ice age when they board a train travelling across the globe.

programme.title: Terminator 2: Judgment Day
programme.desc: John, son of Sarah Connor, sends a reprogrammed Terminator to protect his younger self, who also holds the key to humanity's survival, from the T-1000, an advanced robot created by Skynet.

programme.title: Piranha 3D
programme.desc: An earthquake cracks open the bottom of a lake, releasing a prehistoric species of piranha. As sinister events unfold due to the flesh-eating fish, a group of strangers team up to stop the bloodbath.

programme.title: The Hunger Games: Catching Fire
programme.desc: After their victory in the 74th Hunger Games, Katniss and Peeta must participate in the 75th Annual Hunger Games, featuring all its previous winners.

programme.title: The World Is Not Enough
programme.desc: James Bond, the renowned secret agent, must protect Elektra King, the daughter of an assassinated billionaire. However, things get complicated when he uncovers a terrorist plot threatening the world.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible II
programme.desc: Agent Ethan Hunt fights against a rogue terrorist and rushes to prevent a deadly virus from spreading. To avert a global catastrophe, Ethan has to bring everything to an end.

programme.title: Transformers: Revenge of the Fallen
programme.desc: Sam and Mikaela once again join forces with Optimus Prime and the Autobots to save Earth from The Fallen, the ruthless robot who teams up with the Decepticons.
